North Hills Facility Services offers premier facility and janitorial services for both commercial and residential properties in the NY Metro area, backed by over 50 years of experience. Their extensive range of services includes facility cleaning, emergency response, disinfecting, and specialized maintenance solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of their clients. The company prioritizes creating safe, clean, and productive environments, ensuring high standards of quality and reliability. They serve a diverse clientele, including commercial, industrial, and residential sectors, with a commitment to exceptional customer service and ongoing employee training. 
The company headquarters is located in 265 Executive Drive, Suite 250, Plainview, NY 11803, United States.201-500 Employees

Olnick Rentals specializes in exceptional real estate management, with a focus on residential, office, retail, and hospitality properties. The company has a rich history of managing properties over generations, ensuring high-quality service and client satisfaction. Their intended clients include businesses and individuals seeking reliable real estate management solutions. Olnick Rentals is committed to maintaining and developing properties that meet the diverse needs of their clientele. 
The company headquarters is located in 484 Malcolm X Boulevard, New York, NY 10037, United States.
51-200 Employees

Silvercup Studios also provides facilities for still photography including shoots for fashion magazines such as Vogue, Elle, Mirabella as well as The Source and XXL. Annie Liebowitz's famous cover shot for Bruce Springsteen's Born in the USA album was shot on the company's stages. Many music videos have been produced and shot at the studio for artists such as Beyonce , Madonna, Mariah Carey, Kenny G. Whitney Houston, Janet Jackson, Billy Joel, Bon Jovi, Limp Bizkit, George Michael, Nine Inch Nails, Britney Spears and Justin Timberlake. 
The company headquarters is located in 42-22 22nd Street, Long Island City, NY 11101, United States. 51-200 Employees

Century Management is a prominent full-service property management company based in New York, established in 1971. They specialize in managing a diverse portfolio of residential properties, including rentals, co-ops, and condos, while offering services such as property, financial, and project management. The company is dedicated to enhancing the living experience of residents and maximizing the value of clients' investments through innovative management solutions. With a commitment to quality service and advanced systems, Century Management caters to properties of all sizes, ensuring efficient operations and satisfied residents. 
The company headquarters is located in 440 9th Avenue, 15th Floor, New York, NY 10001, United States. 1K-5K Employees

Tekko Enterprises, Inc., a Tooele, Utah-based prime contractor with a U.S. Air Force contract at Mountain Home Air Force Base (worth over $5 million), an $829,227 U.S. Army Corps of Engineers contract for cranes in Sacramento, and recent projects in Jacob City ($1.21 million), DFCM ($3.5 million), and the Youth Center Boiler House ($138,000), as a result of security negligence, leaked confidential information, including drawings/diagrams/specifications for utility systems (fuel systems, HVAC systems), cranes, employee personal and identifying information, security clearances/ID cards, confidential bids/estimates, and contract prices/financials, in violation of the False Claims Act, DFARS, FISMA, and the Privacy Act.

Gibson Area Hospital & Health Services is a nonprofit community hospital located in Gibson City, Illinois. It provides a range of healthcare services, including emergency care, inpatient and outpatient treatment, diagnostic testing, rehabilitation, primary care, and services for women and newborns

pulmonaryservicesgrouppr.com zoominfo.com/c/pulmonary-services-group/442368923 Pulmonary Services Group (Medicare-enrolled since 1998, pulmonaryservicesgrouppr.com, Santurce/San Juan + Mayagüez, Puerto Rico) is a three-company group — Respiratory Equipment Leasing and Sales Services Corp., Mayagüez Alquiler y Venta, and Pulmonary Equipment Corp — providing home medical equipment and respiratory therapy services across the island and hospital equipment distribution to Puerto Rico and the Caribbean. Its specialty is home mechanical ventilation for ventilator-dependent patients (neonates to elderly), plus CPAP/BiPAP for sleep apnea, oxygen concentrators, speaking valves, enteral feeding and home-care gear (hospital beds, lifts, mattresses). The company holds JCAHO accreditation since 1998 in respiratory therapy and durable medical equipment, accepts Medicare and most local health plans, and offers 24/7 delivery, installation, training and technical support.

corswarem.eu Corswarem Group (founded 1957, Tongeren, Belgium) is a family-owned manufacturer and installer of aluminium windows, doors, curtain-wall facades, terraces and solar panels, with 65+ years of expertise and 18–20 employees across five legal entities (Ramenconstructie Corswarem NV as the main operating company, plus Alu Design, Window Creations, Solar Solutions and holding Groep ADC BV with €18M in assets). It is a Schüco Premium Partner (30+ years exclusive) and Renson Ambassador, delivering full turnkey projects from design through production to installation — landmark works include BASF Antwerpen, Posthofbrug Berchem (17,000 m² offices), DronePort Brustem, CM Limburg HQ and the first ASE 80 HI DesignLine installation in Belgium. Led by the Corswarem family (Dirk, An, Jolien), the group booked a gross margin of €5.3M at its 2023 peak but saw profit fall 64% in 2025 to €691K amid Belgium's construction slowdown — though equity rose 44% and debt dropped 30%.

Polikem is a Colombian company dedicated to the development, manufacture, and marketing of chemical products for industrial and automotive applications. With decades of experience, the company provides practical and reliable solutions tailored to the needs of various industries and consumers.

This leak includes sensitive information, such as the company’s financial status, inventory records, and other internal data. [Sector: Manufacturing]

donhierro.com zoominfo.com/c/don-hierro-sl/347708573 Don Hierro Corporation, S.A. (roots to 1969, Panama City) is a Panama-based engineering, construction and manufacturing firm specializing in hydraulic works, concrete caissons, foundations and industrial building. With ISO 9001/14001/45001 certifications and 39,000 m² of production facilities in Colón (its own concrete plants, quarries and caisson yards), it self-manufactures critical components — a rare vertical integration in Central America. Its flagship client is the Panama Canal Authority (ACP), for which it has executed compensating-platform repairs, drainage works at the Espíritu Santo and Pirro locks and coastal work for the Third Bridge consortium (~$22–28M). It also builds water-supply systems (Caños de Brea, David pipeline with EMPESA), bridges, dams, breakwaters and drip-irrigation (Netafim) agriculture projects. Led by project director Javier Carrillo (34 years experience) and a team claiming 300+ cumulative

guybendana.com Guy José Bendaña-Guerrero & Asociados (roots to 1907, Managua, Nicaragua) is the leading intellectual-property boutique in Nicaragua, specializing in trademarks, patents, industrial designs, copyright, plant varieties and anti-counterfeiting, plus corporate law, regulatory (sanitary registrations) and litigation. It traces its lineage over 100 years through three legal dynasties — founders Henry Caldera & Henry Caldera-Pallais (who secured Nicaragua's first Trademark Law in 1907 and co-founded ASIPI in 1964), then the Caldera generation, and since 1985 Dr. Guy José Bendaña-Guerrero (a former judge, law professor, author and ex-president of ANIPI) alongside his wife Blanca Aragón de Bendaña and their son Julián. Recognized as Nicaragua's top IP firm by Chambers and Partners, Legal 500 and World Trademark Review 1000, it serves global pharmaceutical, technology, fashion and consumer-goods clients from its Bolonia district office in Managua. With 5–10 lawyers

teachenglish.vus.edu.vn zoominfo.com/c/vus---the-english-center/1308758011 VUS (Vietnam USA Society English Centers) (founded 1997, Ho Chi Minh City) is Vietnam's largest English-language school chain — 70+ centers nationwide with 7,000+ staff, 600+ foreign teachers and 250,000+ students a year (3 million cumulative). It runs Cambridge, IELTS (IDP), TOEFL/TOEIC (ETS) and Oxford University Press programs plus a joint degree track with the University of Saint Mary (USA), holding Guinness World Record and Vietnam Record awards. The teachenglish.vus.edu.vn portal recruits TEFL/TESOL/CELTA-qualified native-speaking teachers (~$20–35/hr) with sponsored work visas, housing help, flights and a formal career ladder (Teacher → Head Teacher).

autohoeller.at zoominfo.com/c/auto-höller/431018598 Auto Höller (family business founded 1968 by Erwin and Monika Höller as a small filling station in Seekirchen) is a multi-brand car dealership and workshop in Eugendorf near Salzburg, Austria, employing 32 staff across two locations. It is an official long-standing dealer for Kia (top-5 Kia partner in Austria), Mazda (one of the largest in western Austria) and Isuzu commercial vehicles, selling new, young ("HÖLLISCH GUT" certified) and used cars plus fleet management, financing and a full-service workshop with body shop and §57a inspection station. Since 2006 it has been led by the founder's son Markus Höller (sole owner across three legal entities: GmbH, GmbH & Co KG and an Immobilien company), with total assets of €5.7M as of end-2024. The dealership is locally famous for its humor-driven marketing ("Höllisch gut" branding, cabaret evenings)

tommygarner.com zoominfo.com/c/tommy-garner-air-conditioning--heating/140230813 Tommy Garner Air Conditioning & Heating (Tommy Garner, Inc., founded 1986 by Tommy and Chrissy Garner in Newport News, Virginia) is a family-owned Class A HVAC contractor serving the Hampton Roads region for 40 years. It provides commercial and residential air conditioning, heating, generators (authorized Honeywell dealer), water heaters, commercial refrigeration and indoor air-quality solutions — with 24-hour emergency service, 30-day service guarantees and 1-year installation warranties. Led today by founder Tommy Garner alongside his son Zach and daughter Lauren Jett, the company employs 35–39 people and was named Virginia Peninsula Chamber Small Business of the Year 2024 and a 2025 Best Places to Work in Virginia (the only HVAC firm on the list). Its reputation is exceptional — an A BBB rating and 5-star reviews from clients including the Virginia Living Museum

nnjei.com zoominfo.com/c/northern-nj-eye-institute/70059294 Northern New Jersey Eye Institute / NNJEI (30+ years, nnjei.com, South Orange, NJ) is a family-run ophthalmology practice and ambulatory surgery center with clinics in South Orange, West Caldwell and Elizabeth. It treats cataracts (its signature "no-needle, no-stitch, no-patch" surgery), LASIK/LASEK/PRK vision correction, glaucoma, corneal and retinal disease, diabetic eye care and cosmetic eye services, with its own AAAHC-accredited operating room and acceptance of Medicare plus 13+ insurance plans. Its standout edge is clinical research: lead surgeon Charles J. Crane, MD (4.9/5 from 127 Zocdoc reviews, NJ Top Docs 2024) was among the first ~100 doctors in the US to implant the Glaukos iDose TR and among fewer than 15 in FDA trials for iStent infinite — pioneering MIGS glaucoma treatments, with results published in 2025–26 journals. The practice books about $3.2M revenue with 15–18 staff and holds a solid 79/100 CMS MIPS

dbu-construction.com zoominfo.com/c/dbu-construction-inc/358513059 DBU Construction, Inc. (founded 1998 — "DBU" stands for Directional Boring and Utility, Chichester, New Hampshire) is a specialty contractor focused on trenchless horizontal directional drilling (HDD) and underground utility construction, plus roads, water/sewer, excavation and drainage work. It started drilling for Verizon Telecommunications and now serves municipalities, state and federal agencies (including Pease Air National Guard Base), utilities and developers across six New Hampshire counties and Maine, with roughly $15–25M annual revenue and 11–50 staff. In 2008 Jessica Towne took ownership, making it a Women-Owned Business Enterprise (WBE) and, since 2011, the first WBE in New Hampshire to offer directional drilling (also DBE-certified). Landmark projects include drilling a 1,500-foot waterline under Newfound Lake and gas-line bores under Route 102. Key strengths are its niche HDD expertise, government bid cert

agospap.com zoominfo.com/c/agospap/357851962 AGOSPAP (founded 2 November 1981, Paris) is a non-profit association (loi 1901) that manages social, cultural and leisure benefits for ~150,000 staff of the AP-HP hospital system and the City of Paris plus ~20 affiliated public bodies — effectively a cross-institutional works-council fund. With 45 employees and income tied to 0.5% of the two founders' payroll (≈€28M/year in subsidies; €49M total budget), it provides income-scaled holiday stays, children's camps (4–17), a cultural ticketing platform, Christmas gifts, social grants (birth/marriage/service medals) and the new Pass'Sport sports voucher. Led by president Jean-Paul Brandela (since Oct 2023) and director-general Anne Schaetzel (since 2013), it is ISO 9001-certified and holds an Atout France travel-operator license with UNAT financial guarantees. Funding remains politically sensitive: a €2M cut by the City in 2023 briefly suspended camp registrations
